source: 英语小对话双语句库（DESIGN 2.5）。Claude 预写，家长过目。一句不超过 8 个词，只用她认识的词（小学词和课本 Starter 到 Unit 3 的常见词）；words 是用到的词（原形），tests/lines.test.mjs 粗检。程序只按场景挑编号，不现写句子。按钮问题在 questions.json。

scenes.praise: 夸她，{word} 是今天做对的一个词；tone 是语气：specific 说出做对了什么、self 和她自己以前比、short 一句短的、fact 只说事实不加夸词（家长问卷 on_praise 定默认，intake.js）
scenes.easy: 轻松版；when.reason 按 plan.lightReason（late / exam / dictation / comeback / chosen），作业多的日子是 busy（家长问卷 busy_days）
scenes.dictation: 明天有听写；when.phase：before 开始前、during 一个个读、after 对完答案（wrong 有错 / perfect 全对）、retry 马上再写错的、tonight 睡前那次、morning 出门前看一眼
scenes.exam: 期中季（DESIGN 6.4）；when.exam：season 离考试 4-14 天、quiz 考前 2-3 天小卷、eve 考前一天（早点睡）、day 考试当天、done 考完 1-3 天。不放倒计时，不提分数（lines.examPhase）

when: 可选条件：hour [起, 止) 按 ctx.hour（默认当前小时）；其他键要 ctx 里同名的值相等，true 表示有值且不为 0，false 表示没有

lines.en: Hi {name}! Today is a new day.

lines.zh: 晚上好，{name}！准备好开始了吗？

lines.en: I want to know you better.
Choose one. Any answer is OK.
lines.zh: 选一个吧，怎么选都可以。

lines.en: A small question before you go.
lines.zh: 走之前，问你一个小问题。

lines.en: Here is a question for you.
{word} was new. Now you know it!
lines.zh: {word} 本来是新词，现在你认识了！
记性真好！{word} 你答对了。
真不错！{word} 现在是你的了。

lines.en: {word} was wrong before. Now it is right.
{word} was hard last week. Not today!
lines.zh: 上周 {word} 还很难，今天不难了！

lines.en: You did it! See you tomorrow.
I missed you! Let's start easy.
lines.zh: 想你啦！我们从简单的开始。

lines.en: You're back! Let's do a short one.
lines.zh: 你回来啦！我们来一节短的。

lines.en: No problem. Let's go on today.
Welcome back! Today can be easy.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来！今天可以轻松一点。

lines.en: Every day is a new start.
It's late. Let's do a short one.
lines.zh: 有点晚了，我们做一节短的。

lines.en: It's late. Go to bed early!
Busy day? Let's do the easy one.
lines.zh: 今天忙吗？我们做轻松版。

lines.en: A short lesson today. That's OK!
lines.zh: 今天上一节短课，没关系！
作业多吗？只要 {minutes} 分钟。

lines.en: A little every day is great.
Easy and short. You can do it!
You wrote a lot. Short one tonight.
lines.zh: 你今晚写了不少，现在来一节短的。

lines.en: Lots of homework today? Short and easy.
lines.zh: 今天作业多吗？短一点，轻松一点。

lines.en: Busy day. A short lesson is fine.
Easy one today. Big day tomorrow!
lines.zh: 今天轻松一点，明天是大日子！

lines.en: Welcome back! Let's start with an easy one.
lines.zh: 欢迎回来！我们从轻松的开始。
今天做轻松版？好，开始吧！

lines.en: A short lesson is still a lesson.

lines.zh: 听一个，写一个。准备好了吗？

lines.en: Not sure? Listen one more time.
Good! Now let's look at them.
Some words are new. That's OK.
lines.zh: 有几个词还不熟，没关系。

lines.en: Look at them again before bed.
You got them all! Ready for tomorrow.
One word at a time. Ready?
lines.zh: 一次一个词。准备好了吗？

lines.en: I read each word two times.
Write what you hear. Let's start.
lines.zh: 听到什么就写什么。开始吧。

lines.en: Next one. You can do it.
Good. Here is the next word.
Not sure? Write what you think.

lines.zh: 写完啦！我们一起来对答案。

lines.en: Look at each word. Right or wrong?
It's OK to be wrong. Try again.
These words will come back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 这几个词明天还会出现。

lines.en: Every word is right. Great work!
No wrong words today. Well done!
lines.zh: 今天一个都没错，做得好！
明天的听写你准备好了。

lines.en: Just these words again. On paper.
lines.zh: 只写这几个，还是写在纸上。
再来一遍！听一个写一个。

lines.en: Just one minute. Write these again.
lines.zh: 只要一分钟，再写这几个。
今晚最后一次，然后休息。

lines.en: Good morning! Look at these first.
Two minutes, then go to school.
The words from last night. Look again.
lines.zh: 昨晚的那几个词，再看一眼。

lines.en: Read them one time. You are ready.
Have a good day at school!
Hi {name}! Let's review the old words.
Old words today. You know many!
lines.zh: 今天复习旧词，你已经认识很多了！

lines.en: A little review every day helps.

lines.zh: 复习时间到！准备好了吗，{name}？

lines.en: Today we look at words you learned.
lines.zh: 今天我们看看你学过的词。
今天做一份小卷子，准备好了吗？

lines.en: It is short. You can do it.
No hurry. Just do your best.
Take your time with each one.
Big day tomorrow. Go to bed early!
lines.zh: 明天是大日子，今天早点睡！

lines.en: Just a short one. Then sleep early.
lines.zh: 只做一节短的，然后早点睡。

lines.en: You are ready. Sleep well tonight.
lines.zh: 你准备好了。今晚好好睡。
今晚轻松一点，好好休息。

lines.en: Today was a big day. Rest well.
lines.zh: 今天是个大日子，好好休息。

lines.en: The test is over. You worked hard!
No more tests. Back to our lessons!
lines.zh: 考完啦，我们回到平常的课！

tone: 可选，只在 praise 里用：ctx.tone 给了时优先挑带这个 tone 的句子，没有就照常挑
talk_note: “老师说 + 学一点”（Wei 10-25）：首页招呼和收尾不再只说 Hi / See you，换成一句有意思的英文（生词不超过 1 个）加一行“学一点”。kind 轮换：idiom 地道说法、unit 课本单元小知识、cat 猫的小笑话和冷知识、mix 易混词、day 星期几 / 节日 / 天气、origin 单词来历、twister 绕口令；scene 是能出现的场景（open / close / back / late / exam）；level 1-3 难度；unit 是要学到哪个单元才出（S、U1…U6）；topic 对上她在“我”里选的喜好时优先；when 同 lines，另认 weekday（1 周一…7 周日）、month [起, 止)（可跨年，[11, 3] 是 11 月到 2 月）、near（MM-DD，节日当天，before 提前几天）、dates（农历节日的公历日子）。learn.add 是可以加进单词本的词或短语。个性化的几类在 talk_make，由 lines.js 填空。

talks.en: Look outside! It's raining cats and dogs.

learn.zh: 雨下得特别大。下大雨的时候说，天上可没有真的掉猫和狗。

talks.en: Tell me about your day. I'm all ears.
talks.zh: 说说你今天怎么样，我认真听着呢。

learn.zh: 我洗耳恭听，你说吧。想认真听别人讲话的时候说。

talks.en: Today's words? A piece of cake!

learn.zh: 小菜一碟，很容易。This test is a piece of cake. 这次小测很容易。

talks.en: Time flies when you have fun.
talks.zh: 开心的时候，时间过得飞快。

learn.zh: 时间过得真快。玩得开心、聊得高兴的时候常说。

talks.en: Shh! Don't let the cat out of the bag.

learn.text: let the cat out of the bag
learn.zh: 说漏嘴，把秘密说出去。Who let the cat out of the bag? 谁把秘密说出去了？

add.w: let the cat out of the bag

talks.en: Practice makes perfect, {name}.

learn.zh: 熟能生巧。练得多了，就做得好。

talks.en: Start now. Better late than never!
talks.zh: 现在开始。晚做也比不做好！

learn.zh: 晚一点也比不做好。迟到了、晚交了，也可以这样给自己打气。

talks.en: Easy does it. One word at a time.

learn.zh: 慢慢来，别着急。做一件要小心的事之前说。

talks.en: Keep your chin up today!

learn.zh: chin 是下巴。抬起下巴，就是“别灰心，打起精神”。

talks.en: Is your little brother a copycat?
talks.zh: 你家小弟弟是不是学人精？

learn.zh: 学人精，总学别人的人。小孩子之间常说：Stop being a copycat! 别学我啦！

talks.en: I need a catnap after lunch.

learn.zh: 小睡一会儿，像猫一样打个盹。take a catnap = 打个盹。

talks.en: My cat is a scaredy-cat. She hides!
talks.zh: 我的猫是个胆小鬼，一有动静就躲起来！

learn.zh: 胆小鬼（开玩笑的说法）。Don't be a scaredy-cat! 别当胆小鬼啦！

talks.en: No words today? Cat got your tongue?
talks.zh: 今天怎么不说话？舌头被猫叼走啦？

learn.zh: 怎么不说话啦？别人突然不吭声时，开玩笑地问。

talks.en: Hit the books, then hit the hay!
talks.zh: 先用功读书，再上床睡觉！

learn.zh: 上床睡觉。hit the books 是“用功读书”。两个 hit 意思不一样。

talks.en: Are you under the weather? Rest a little.
talks.zh: 你是不是不太舒服？休息一下吧。

learn.zh: 有点不舒服。感冒了、没精神的时候说：I feel a bit under the weather.

talks.en: You did it! I am over the moon!
talks.zh: 你做到了！我高兴得不得了！

learn.zh: 高兴极了，高兴得能跳过月亮。

talks.en: Once in a blue moon, I eat cake for breakfast.
talks.zh: 我难得一次早饭吃蛋糕。

learn.zh: 难得一次，很少。blue moon 是一个月里的第二次满月，很少见。

talks.en: Cats are cute? You can say that again!

learn.zh: 说得太对了！完全同意的时候说，不是真让你再说一遍。

talks.en: Long time no see, {name}!

learn.zh: 好久不见！据说这句和中文的“好久不见”有关，现在说英语的人都这么说。

talks.en: Fingers crossed for you!

learn.zh: 祝好运！说的时候可以把食指和中指交叉起来。

talks.en: Rise and shine, {name}!

learn.zh: 起床啦，打起精神！早上叫人起床时说。

talks.en: Good night, {name}. Sleep tight!

learn.zh: 睡个好觉！常和晚安连着说：Good night, sleep tight! 读起来押韵。

talks.en: Learn these words by heart.

learn.zh: 背下来，记熟。I learn the poem by heart. 我把这首诗背下来了。

talks.en: Ask a friend. Two heads are better than one!
talks.zh: 问问朋友吧，两个人一起想更好！

learn.text: Two heads are better than one.
learn.zh: 两个人一起想，比一个人强。和同学一起学的时候说。

add.w: Two heads are better than one.
add.cn: 两个人一起想比一个人强

talks.en: Hang in there! The weekend is coming.

learn.zh: 坚持住！累的时候互相打气。

talks.en: Way to go, {name}!

learn.zh: 干得好！夸别人做成了一件事。

talks.en: Hard work today? No pain, no gain!
talks.zh: 今天很辛苦？不吃苦就没收获！

learn.zh: 不付出就没有收获。pain 是疼、辛苦，gain 是得到。

talks.en: I'm a night owl. Are you?

learn.zh: 夜猫子，喜欢晚睡的人。英语里说的是“夜里的猫头鹰”。早起的人叫 early bird。

talks.en: Up early? The early bird catches the worm!
talks.zh: 起得早？早起的鸟儿有虫吃！

learn.text: The early bird catches the worm.
learn.zh: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃。早起的人可以叫 an early bird。

talks.en: Busy as a bee today?

learn.zh: 忙得像小蜜蜂一样。I am as busy as a bee. 我忙极了。

talks.en: Be as quiet as a mouse. The cat is sleeping.
talks.zh: 像小老鼠一样安静，猫在睡觉呢。

learn.zh: 安静得像只小老鼠。as ... as 中间放形容词：as cute as a cat。

talks.en: Ten new words tomorrow? It's a deal!
talks.zh: 明天学十个新词？一言为定！

learn.zh: 一言为定！说好了一件事的时候说。

talks.en: Take it easy tonight.

learn.zh: 放轻松，别累着。也可以当“再见”说：Take it easy!

talks.en: Do you feel butterflies before a test?
talks.zh: 考试前，你会紧张得心里七上八下吗？

learn.zh: 紧张得心里七上八下，像肚子里有蝴蝶在飞。

talks.en: My cat fell down, but she is OK. Nine lives!
talks.zh: 我的猫摔了一下，没事。九条命嘛！

learn.zh: 猫有九条命。中文也这么说，英语一模一样！

talks.en: Stay cool as a cucumber in the test.
talks.zh: 考试的时候要冷静，像黄瓜一样凉。

learn.zh: 非常冷静。黄瓜摸起来凉凉的，所以用来说人很镇定。

talks.en: Let's get the ball rolling!

learn.zh: 开个头，开始干。把球滚起来，事情就动起来了。

talks.en: Hi {name}! What's up?

learn.zh: 最近怎么样？朋友之间打招呼。回答可以说 Not much. 没什么特别的。

talks.en: Hey {name}! How's it going?

learn.zh: 最近怎么样？回答：Pretty good! 挺好的！

talks.en: Welcome back, {name}! I missed you.

learn.zh: miss 有两个意思：想念，还有错过。I missed the bus. 我没赶上公交车。

talks.en: Welcome back! Let's pick up where we left off.
talks.zh: 欢迎回来！我们从上次停下的地方接着来。

learn.text: pick up where we left off
learn.zh: 从上次停下的地方接着做。看书、上课中断以后常说。

add.w: pick up where we left off
add.cn: 从上次停下的地方继续

talks.en: Welcome back! Every day is a fresh start.
talks.zh: 欢迎回来！每天都是新的开始。

learn.zh: 一个新的开始。fresh 是“新鲜的”：fresh fruit 新鲜水果，fresh air 新鲜空气。

talks.en: Hey, stranger! Good to see you.
talks.zh: 嘿，好久不见的“陌生人”！见到你真好。

learn.zh: 好久没见的朋友，开玩笑地叫一声“陌生人”。只对熟人这样说。

talks.en: Welcome back! Let's go step by step.
talks.zh: 欢迎回来！我们一步一步来。

learn.zh: 一步一步地。Learn English step by step. 一步一步学英语。

talks.en: It's late. Count sheep, not words!
talks.zh: 很晚了。去数羊吧，别数单词了！

learn.zh: 数羊。睡不着的时候说。sheep 的复数还是 sheep，不加 s。

talks.en: See you later, alligator!

learn.text: See you later, alligator! / In a while, crocodile!
learn.zh: 押韵的说再见，英语小朋友常玩。对方回一句 In a while, crocodile!

talks.en: Catch you later, {name}!

learn.zh: 回头见！比 See you later 更随意，朋友之间说。

talks.en: Take care! See you tomorrow.

learn.zh: 保重！说再见时常加一句，大人小孩都用。

talks.en: That's all for today. Bye for now!
talks.zh: 今天就到这里，先说再见啦！

learn.zh: 先说到这儿，回头见。for now 是“暂时、眼下”。

talks.en: Good job today! Give me five!

learn.zh: 击个掌！举起手掌拍一下。也可以说 High five!

talks.en: You worked hard. Time to chill!
talks.zh: 你很努力了，歇一会儿吧！

learn.zh: 放松，歇一歇（口语）。Let's chill! 我们歇会儿吧！

talks.en: Same time tomorrow?

learn.zh: 明天老时间见？约下一次时这么说，回答 Sure! 好呀！

talks.en: Big day tomorrow. Go to bed early!

learn.zh: 重要的日子。Tomorrow is a big day. 明天是重要的一天。

talks.en: Sleep well tonight. You've got this!
talks.zh: 今晚睡个好觉，早点睡。你能行的！

learn.zh: 你能行的！给人打气时说。

talks.en: Today's the day! Break a leg!

learn.zh: 祝你好运！演出、比赛、考试之前说，可不是让你摔断腿。

talks.en: Review a little every day. Slow and steady!

learn.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
learn.zh: 慢而稳，才能赢。来自龟兔赛跑的故事：The Tortoise and the Hare。

talks.en: One step at a time, {name}.

learn.zh: 一步一步来，别急。复习很多的时候这样想就好。

talks.en: The test is over. Phew!

learn.zh: （松一口气）呼！终于结束了。It's over! 结束了！

talks.en: The test is over. Time to relax!

learn.zh: 放松！relax 是放松，relaxed 是“很放松的”：I feel relaxed.

talks.en: We say good morning until twelve o'clock.
talks.zh: 中午十二点以前，我们说早上好。

learn.text: Good morning / Good afternoon / Good evening
learn.zh: 中午 12 点前说 Good morning，下午 Good afternoon，晚上见面 Good evening。Good night 是睡前道别用的。
learn.say: Good morning. Good afternoon. Good evening.

talks.en: Can I use your eraser? Or your rubber?

learn.zh: 橡皮：美国人说 eraser，英国人常说 rubber。

talks.en: Sorry, how do you spell it?

learn.zh: 怎么拼？没听清单词的时候，可以这样问老师和同学。

talks.en: Nice to meet you! Nice to meet you, too!
talks.zh: 很高兴认识你！我也很高兴认识你！

learn.zh: 第一次见面说。对方回答 Nice to meet you, too. 以后再见面就说 Nice to see you。

talks.en: In the UK, many students wear uniforms.
talks.zh: 在英国，很多学生穿校服。

learn.zh: 校服。英国很多中学的校服有西装外套，还要打领带。

talks.en: Junior high is a new start for you!
talks.zh: 初中对你来说是一个新的开始！

learn.zh: 初中 junior high，高中 senior high。junior 是“年纪小一些的”，senior 是“年纪大一些的”。

talks.en: What's your favourite subject?

learn.zh: 科目。My favourite subject is art. 我最喜欢美术课。英国拼 favourite，美国拼 favorite。

talks.en: Can you help me? Sure!

learn.zh: 当然可以！别人请你帮忙时，Sure! 比 Yes. 更热情。

talks.en: Basketball started with two fruit baskets!
talks.zh: 篮球最早用的是两个水果篮！

learn.zh: 1891 年发明篮球时，用的是两个装桃子的篮子。每进一个球，都要有人把球拿出来。

talks.en: Table tennis has another name!

learn.zh: 乒乓球。ping-pong 学的是小球弹来弹去的声音。

talks.en: Join a club. It's more than fun!
talks.zh: 参加个社团吧，不只是好玩！

learn.zh: 参加社团。I want to join the music club. 我想参加音乐社。

talks.en: Do you play the piano or play football?

learn.zh: 乐器前面加 the：play the piano；球类不加：play football。

talks.en: Volleyball is more than a hundred years old.
talks.zh: 排球已经有一百多年了。

learn.zh: 排球 1895 年在美国发明。volley 是“球落地前把它打回去”。

talks.en: Your cousin can be a boy or a girl.
talks.zh: 你的 cousin 可以是男孩，也可以是女孩。

learn.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹、表兄弟姐妹，英语都叫 cousin，不分男女，也不分堂和表。

talks.en: In English, aunt can mean many people!
talks.zh: 英语里，aunt 可以是好几个人！

learn.zh: 姑姑、姨妈、婶婶、舅妈都是 aunt；叔叔、伯伯、舅舅、姑父都是 uncle。

talks.en: My mum's mum is my grandma.
talks.zh: 妈妈的妈妈是我的外婆。

learn.zh: 外婆、奶奶都是 grandma；外公、爷爷都是 grandpa。

talks.en: Like father, like son!

learn.zh: 儿子像爸爸。女孩像妈妈可以说 Like mother, like daughter.

talks.en: In the UK, there is a Pancake Day!

learn.zh: 英国的煎饼日在春天。大家在家做薄饼，有的地方还举行边跑边翻饼的比赛。

talks.en: We say Happy New Year at Spring Festival.

learn.zh: 春节。红包叫 red packet 或 red envelope。

talks.en: How do you celebrate your birthday?

learn.zh: 庆祝。Let's celebrate! 我们来庆祝吧！

talks.en: Thanksgiving is in November in the US.
talks.zh: 美国的感恩节在十一月。

learn.zh: 感恩节在美国是 11 月的第四个星期四，很多家庭一起吃火鸡（turkey）。

talks.en: Some bamboo grows very, very fast!
talks.zh: 有的竹子长得特别特别快！

learn.zh: 竹子。有的竹子一天能长将近 1 米，是长得最快的植物之一。熊猫最爱吃它。

talks.en: Fun fact: a banana is a berry!
talks.zh: 冷知识：香蕉是一种浆果！

learn.zh: 按植物学的分法，香蕉算浆果，草莓反而不算。berry 是浆果：blueberry 蓝莓。

talks.en: Young sunflowers follow the sun.
talks.zh: 小向日葵会跟着太阳转。

learn.zh: 向日葵。还没长大的向日葵白天跟着太阳转，长大以后大多一直朝着东边。

talks.en: Is a tomato a fruit or a vegetable?

learn.zh: 按植物学，番茄是果实；做饭时大家当蔬菜用。复数加 es：tomatoes，potatoes。

talks.en: We can't live without plants.

learn.zh: without 是“没有”。plants 给我们空气、食物和木头。

talks.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

learn.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
learn.zh: 你需要帮助时还在你身边的，才是真朋友。

add.w: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

talks.en: Who is your best friend?

learn.zh: 最好的朋友。年轻人写 BFF，就是 best friends forever，永远的好朋友。

add.cn: 永远的好朋友（best friends forever）

talks.en: Make new friends, but keep the old.
talks.zh: 交新朋友，也别忘了老朋友。

learn.text: Make new friends, but keep the old. One is silver and the other gold.
learn.zh: 一首英文儿歌：新朋友是银子，老朋友是金子。

talks.en: An elephant never forgets a friend.

learn.zh: 大象记性很好。英语里说一个人记性好，就说他像大象。

talks.en: What is a cat's favourite colour?

learn.zh: 紫色！purr 是猫打呼噜的声音，听起来像 purple（紫色）。

talks.en: Why did the cat sit on the computer?

learn.text: To keep an eye on the mouse!
learn.zh: 为了盯着老鼠！mouse 是老鼠，也是鼠标。keep an eye on 是“盯着、看着”。

talks.en: What is a cat's favourite dessert?
talks.zh: 猫最喜欢的甜点是什么？

learn.zh: 老鼠冰淇淋！mice 是 mouse 的复数，连起来读像 ice cream。

talks.en: What is a cat's favourite subject at school?

learn.zh: 历史课！猫生气时会发出 hiss（嘶嘶）声，hiss 听着像 history 的开头。

talks.en: What do you call lots of kittens?

learn.zh: 一座喵山！meow（喵）+ mountain（山）。

talks.en: Why was the cat afraid of the tree?

learn.zh: 因为它的树皮！bark 是树皮，也是狗叫声。

talks.en: What is a cat's favourite song?

learn.zh: 《三只瞎老鼠》，一首有名的英文儿歌。猫当然最爱听这首！

talks.en: What does a cat say when it is surprised?

learn.zh: 喵哇！meow（喵）+ wow（哇）。

talks.en: Why are cats good at video games?
talks.zh: 猫为什么玩游戏很厉害？

learn.zh: 因为它们有九条命！游戏里的“命”英语也叫 life，复数 lives。

talks.en: Which cat loves the water?

learn.zh: 章鱼猫！octopus（章鱼）听着像 octo-puss，puss 是“猫咪”。

talks.en: Cats sleep more than half the day!
talks.zh: 猫一天要睡一大半的时间！

learn.zh: 猫一天大约睡 12 到 16 个小时。a day 在这里是“每天”。
learn.say: about twelve to sixteen hours a day

talks.en: Cats can't taste sweet food.

learn.zh: 四种味道：甜 sweet，酸 sour，苦 bitter，咸 salty。猫吃不出甜。

talks.en: Big cats meow to people, not to cats.
talks.zh: 大猫喵喵叫，主要是说给人听的。

learn.zh: 大猫之间很少喵喵叫，它们用身体和眼睛“说话”。喵，是专门说给人听的。

talks.en: Every cat has its own nose print.
talks.zh: 每只猫的鼻纹都不一样。

learn.zh: 每只猫的鼻子纹路都不一样，就像人的指纹 fingerprint。

talks.en: Cats have five toes on each front paw.
talks.zh: 猫的每只前爪有五个趾头。

learn.zh: 猫前爪五个趾，后爪四个。paw 是动物的爪子，toe 是脚趾。

talks.en: All kittens have blue eyes at first.
talks.zh: 小猫刚出生时，眼睛都是蓝色的。

learn.zh: 小猫刚生下来眼睛是蓝的，长大才慢慢变颜色。kitten 是小猫，puppy 是小狗。

talks.en: A cat can turn its ears around!

learn.zh: 猫的耳朵能转很大的角度，去找声音在哪儿。turn around 是“转过来”。

talks.en: Tabby cats have an M on their heads.
talks.zh: 虎斑猫的头上有个 M。

learn.zh: 虎斑猫的额头上常有一个 M 形的花纹。tabby cat 就是虎斑猫。

talks.en: In Japan, a black cat can mean good luck.
talks.zh: 在日本，黑猫可能代表好运。

learn.zh: 在日本和英国，黑猫常被当作好运。祝别人好运说 Good luck!

talks.en: A group of cats is called a clowder.

learn.zh: 一群猫是 a clowder of cats，一窝小猫是 a litter of kittens。

talks.en: Cats sweat from their feet!

learn.zh: 猫只在爪子的肉垫上出汗。sweat 是出汗，也是汗水。

talks.en: Cats love boxes. Do you know why?
talks.zh: 猫喜欢纸箱子，你知道为什么吗？

learn.zh: 钻进小盒子，猫会觉得安全。feel safe 是“觉得安全”。

talks.en: Hello Kitty has a twin sister!
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 有一个双胞胎妹妹！

learn.zh: 她叫 Mimmy。Kitty 的蝴蝶结戴在左耳，Mimmy 的戴在右耳。twin 是双胞胎。

talks.en: Hello Kitty's full name is Kitty White.
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 的全名叫 Kitty White。

learn.zh: Kitty 是名（first name），White 是姓（last name）。英语里名在前，姓在后。

talks.en: Hello Kitty lives near London.
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 住在伦敦附近。

learn.zh: 设定里她住在英国伦敦郊外。英国的首都是伦敦，London。

talks.en: Hello Kitty is five apples tall!
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 有五个苹果那么高！

learn.zh: 设定里她有 5 个苹果高、3 个苹果重。说身高：I am 160 centimetres tall.

talks.en: Hello Kitty first came out in 1974.
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 是 1974 年出现的。

learn.zh: come out 是（书、电影、新东西）出来、面世。1975 年她被印在一个小钱包上开始卖。

talks.en: Hello Kitty has a pet cat, too!
talks.zh: Hello Kitty 自己也养了一只猫！

learn.zh: 她的宠物是一只白猫，叫 Charmmy Kitty。pet 是宠物：Do you have a pet?

talks.en: Cats climb up trees easily. Coming down is hard!

learn.zh: 猫的爪子往后弯，往上爬抓得牢，下来时常常要倒着退。

talks.en: Cats have a third eyelid.

learn.zh: 猫的眼角藏着第三层薄薄的眼皮，用来保护眼睛。first、second、third：第一、第二、第三。

talks.en: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
talks.zh: 一天一个苹果，医生远离我。

learn.zh: 元音开头的音前用 an：an apple, an hour；其他用 a：a cat, a uniform（uniform 读 /juː/ 开头，所以用 a）。

talks.en: It's my cat. Its name is Mimi.
talks.zh: 这是我的猫，它的名字叫 Mimi。

learn.zh: it's 是 it is；its 是“它的”。It's a cat. Its name is Mimi.

talks.en: Two cats want to play, too!

learn.zh: two 是二，to 是“去、向”，too 是“也”。三个读音一样。

talks.en: Come here! Can you hear me?

learn.zh: here 这里，hear 听见。hear 里面藏着 ear（耳朵），这样好记。

talks.en: Look over there! Their cat is so cute.
talks.zh: 看那边！他们的猫好可爱。

learn.zh: there 是“那里”，their 是“他们的”。they → their，就像 I → my。

talks.en: The library is quite quiet.

learn.zh: quiet /ˈkwaɪət/ 安静的，读两个音节；quite /kwaɪt/ 相当，读一个音节。

talks.en: I can see the sea!

learn.zh: see 看见，sea 大海。读音一样，写法不同。

talks.en: Look at the sun, my son!

learn.zh: sun 太阳，son 儿子。读音一样。son 里的 o 读 /ʌ/。

talks.en: Write the right answer.

learn.zh: write 写（w 不发音），right 对的、右边。两个词读音一样。

talks.en: No, I don't know.

learn.zh: know 知道（k 不发音），no 不。读音一样。knife 刀、knee 膝盖的 k 也不发音。

talks.en: Bye! I'll buy it by Friday.

learn.zh: buy 买，by 在……之前、在旁边，bye 再见。三个读音一样。

talks.en: How many cats? How much milk?

learn.zh: 能数的用 many：many cats；数不清的用 much：much milk, much water。

talks.en: Look! Can you see it? Let's watch TV.
talks.zh: 看！你看见了吗？我们看电视吧。

learn.zh: look 是去看（往这边看），see 是看见了，watch 是盯着看会动的东西，比如电视、比赛。

talks.en: Say hello. Tell me a story.
talks.zh: 打个招呼。给我讲个故事。

learn.zh: say 后面接说的话：say hello；tell 后面接人：tell me。speak English 说语言，talk to me 跟我聊。

talks.en: The game is fun. The joke is funny.
talks.zh: 这个游戏好玩，这个笑话好笑。

learn.zh: fun 是好玩、让人开心；funny 是好笑、让人笑出来。

talks.en: The book is interesting. I'm interested!
talks.zh: 这本书很有意思，我很感兴趣！

learn.zh: 东西有意思用 interesting；人感兴趣用 interested。boring 和 bored 也一样。

talks.en: You did well. Good work!

learn.zh: good 用来说东西：a good book；well 说做得怎么样：You sing well.

talks.en: I am a student. They are students.

learn.zh: I 用 am，he、she、it 用 is，you、we、they 用 are。

talks.en: My mum? She is a teacher.

learn.zh: 男的用 he，女的用 she。说妈妈、姐姐、女老师，都用 she。

talks.en: This cat is white. These cats are black.
talks.zh: 这只猫是白的，这些猫是黑的。

learn.zh: 一个用 this，几个用 these，后面名词加 s：these cats。远的用 that / those。

talks.en: There is a cat. There are two dogs.

learn.zh: 看后面紧跟的名词：一个用 there is，两个以上用 there are。

talks.en: See you at seven on Monday!

learn.zh: 几点用 at：at seven；星期几用 on：on Monday；月份用 in：in May。

talks.en: Lend me your pen? I'll give it back.
talks.zh: 把笔借给我好吗？我会还你的。

learn.zh: borrow 是借进来，lend 是借出去。Can I borrow your pen? 就等于 Can you lend me your pen?

talks.en: Do you like cats? Does she like dogs?
talks.zh: 你喜欢猫吗？她喜欢狗吗？

learn.zh: I、you、we、they 用 do；he、she、it 用 does。does 后面的动词不加 s：Does she like dogs?

talks.en: This is my book. It's mine.

learn.zh: my 后面要跟东西：my book；mine 自己就够了：It's mine. your / yours 也一样。

talks.en: She can swim. He can dance.

learn.zh: can 后面的动词不加 s，can 自己也不加 s：She can swim.

talks.en: It's late. Even my cat is asleep!
talks.zh: 很晚了，连我的猫都睡着了！

learn.zh: asleep 是“睡着了”（状态）：The cat is asleep. sleep 是睡觉（动作）：I sleep at ten.

talks.en: It's late. Let's be quick tonight.
talks.zh: 很晚了，今晚我们快一点。

learn.zh: 早 early，晚 late。Go to bed early! 早点睡！Don't be late! 别迟到！

talks.en: Read the question twice.

learn.zh: once 一次，twice 两次，three times 三次。考试时，题目读两遍再选。

talks.en: Check your answers once more.

learn.zh: check 是检查。Check your spelling! 检查拼写！

talks.en: It's Monday. A new week, a new start!
talks.zh: 星期一，新的一周，新的开始！

learn.zh: Monday 来自“月亮日”（Moon day）。Sunday 是太阳日。

talks.en: Monday again! Do you have the Monday blues?
talks.zh: 又是星期一！你有“星期一综合症”吗？

learn.zh: 星期一不想上学上班的心情。blue 除了蓝色，还有“难过”的意思：I feel blue.

talks.en: It's Tuesday. Do you know its story?
talks.zh: 今天星期二，你知道它名字的来历吗？

learn.zh: 星期二来自古代北欧的神 Tiw：Tiw's day。拼写注意 ue：T-u-e-s-day。

talks.en: It's Wednesday. The week is half done!
talks.zh: 星期三了，这周过了一半！

learn.zh: 第一个 d 不发音，读 /ˈwenzdeɪ/。拼的时候心里读 Wed-nes-day。

talks.en: It's Thursday. Just one more day!

learn.zh: 星期四来自雷神 Thor：Thor's day。th 要把舌尖放在上下牙中间。

talks.en: Friday! Thank goodness it's Friday!

learn.zh: Thank goodness it's Friday 的缩写，周末前大家常说。

talks.en: It's Friday. What are your weekend plans?
talks.zh: 星期五了，周末有什么打算？

learn.text: at the weekend / on the weekend
learn.zh: 在周末：英国说 at the weekend，美国说 on the weekend。

talks.en: It's Saturday. Sleep in a little!
talks.zh: 星期六了，多睡一会儿吧！

learn.zh: 多睡一会儿，晚点起床。On Saturday I sleep in. Saturday 来自土星 Saturn。

talks.en: Sunday is sun day. Is it sunny?
talks.zh: 星期天是太阳日。今天出太阳了吗？

learn.zh: sun 太阳，sunny 晴朗的。今天是 Sunday，天气 sunny 就更好了。

talks.en: What's the weather like today?

learn.zh: 问天气。回答：It's sunny. 晴天。It's windy. 有风。It's cloudy. 多云。

talks.en: It's freezing outside! Wear a warm coat.
talks.zh: 外面冷极了！穿件暖和的外套。

learn.zh: cold 是冷，freezing 是冻得发僵的那种冷。I'm freezing! 我快冻僵了！

talks.en: Do you like snow? Let's make a snowman!
talks.zh: 你喜欢雪吗？我们堆个雪人吧！

learn.zh: 雪人。复数是 snowmen，和 man → men 一样。

talks.en: Spring is here! Flowers are everywhere.

learn.zh: 春天。spring 还有“弹簧”和“泉水”的意思。

talks.en: It's so hot! Time for ice cream.

learn.zh: 冰淇淋。一句有名的绕口令：I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream!

talks.en: Leaves fall in autumn. Americans say fall!
talks.zh: 秋天树叶落下。美国人就叫秋天 fall！

learn.zh: 秋天：英国说 autumn，美国说 fall，因为树叶在这时落下（fall）。

talks.en: Halloween is coming soon!

learn.zh: 万圣节在 10 月 31 日。孩子们穿上怪物衣服去敲门要糖，说的就是这句。

talks.en: Today is Hello Kitty's birthday!
talks.zh: 今天是 Hello Kitty 的生日！

learn.zh: Hello Kitty 的生日是 11 月 1 日。一起说：Happy birthday, Hello Kitty!

talks.en: Today is Thanksgiving in the US.

learn.zh: 感恩节可以对家人说：Thank you for everything. 谢谢你为我做的一切。

talks.en: Tonight is Christmas Eve.

learn.zh: eve 是“前一天晚上”。New Year's Eve 是 12 月 31 日，跨年夜。

talks.en: Merry Christmas, {name}!

learn.zh: 圣诞快乐！merry 是“快乐的”，平时很少用，几乎只在这句里出现。

talks.en: It's the last day of the year!
talks.zh: 今天是一年的最后一天！

learn.zh: 12 月 31 日跨年夜。零点前大家一起倒数：Ten, nine, eight...

talks.en: Happy New Year! New year, new words!
talks.zh: 新年快乐！新的一年，新的单词！

learn.zh: 新年决心。My New Year's resolution: read every day. 我的新年决心：每天读一点。

talks.en: Today is the shortest day of the year.
talks.zh: 今天是一年里白天最短的一天。

learn.zh: 冬至，白天最短。北方冬至吃饺子，饺子叫 dumplings。

talks.en: Happy Spring Festival! Happy New Year!

learn.zh: 红包，英语叫 red packet 或 red envelope。拿到红包别忘了说 Thank you!

talks.en: Today is the Lantern Festival.

learn.zh: 灯笼。元宵节就叫 Lantern Festival，汤圆可以说 sweet rice balls。

talks.en: Happy Dragon Boat Festival!

learn.zh: 龙舟 dragon boat，粽子 rice dumpling，也有人直接说 zongzi。

talks.en: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Look at the moon.
talks.zh: 中秋节快乐！看看月亮吧。

learn.zh: 月饼就是 moon + cake。满月叫 full moon。

talks.en: Happy Teachers' Day!

learn.zh: teachers 是复数，已经有 s 了，所以撇号放在 s 后面：teachers'。

talks.en: Happy National Day! Enjoy your holiday.
talks.zh: 国庆节快乐！好好过假期。

learn.zh: 假期：英国说 holiday，美国常说 vacation。

talks.en: Happy Children's Day!

learn.zh: child 的复数是 children，不加 s。所以写 Children's Day。

talks.en: Be careful today. It's April Fool's Day!

learn.zh: 愚人节。开完玩笑，大家会笑着喊 April Fool! 上当啦！

talks.en: Sunday is Mother's Day. Say thanks to Mum!
talks.zh: 星期天是母亲节，跟妈妈说声谢谢！

learn.zh: 母亲节在 5 月的第二个星期天。可以说：Happy Mother's Day, Mum! I love you.

talks.en: Why do we call it breakfast?

learn.zh: fast 在这里是“不吃东西”。睡了一夜没吃饭，早饭就是“打破不吃饭”。

talks.en: Goodbye was once four words!

learn.zh: 古时候人们说 God be with you，意思是“愿上帝与你同在”，说着说着就缩成了 goodbye。

talks.en: Sandwich was a place name, then a food!
talks.zh: sandwich 原来是个地名，后来才是食物！

learn.zh: 英国有位桑威奇伯爵（Earl of Sandwich），据说他边玩牌边吃夹肉面包，大家就把它叫作 sandwich。

talks.en: Hamburgers come from a city's name!
talks.zh: 汉堡的名字来自一座城市！

learn.zh: 名字来自德国城市汉堡（Hamburg），和火腿（ham）没关系。

talks.en: Ketchup may come from Chinese!
talks.zh: 番茄酱这个词可能来自中文！

learn.zh: 很多人认为 ketchup 来自闽南话里一种鱼酱的叫法，发音像 kê-tsiap。

talks.en: Tea came from Chinese, too!
talks.zh: tea 这个词也来自中文！

learn.zh: tea 来自闽南话“茶”的读音 te。俄语叫茶 chai，是从“茶 cha”的读音来的。

talks.en: Some Chinese words are English words now.
talks.zh: 有些中文词，现在也是英语单词了。

learn.zh: 这些词从中文借进了英语：功夫、豆腐、点心。

talks.en: The word robot is about one hundred years old.
talks.zh: robot 这个词才一百岁左右。

learn.zh: 1920 年一部捷克话剧第一次用了 robot 这个词，原来的意思是“干苦活的人”。

talks.en: A window was once a wind eye!

learn.zh: 古代北欧的话里，窗户叫“风的眼睛”，风从这个“眼睛”吹进来。

talks.en: A daisy is a day's eye.

learn.zh: 雏菊白天开、晚上合，像白天睁开的眼睛。

talks.en: Kindergarten means a garden for children.
talks.zh: 幼儿园的意思是“孩子的花园”。

learn.zh: 来自德语：Kinder 是孩子，Garten 是花园。

talks.en: A hippo is a river horse!

learn.zh: 来自希腊语，意思是“河里的马”。太长了，平时说 hippo 就好。

talks.en: Do you know what dinosaur means?
talks.zh: 你知道 dinosaur 是什么意思吗？

learn.zh: 来自希腊语“可怕的蜥蜴”。中文“恐龙”的“恐”就是这么来的。

talks.en: Television means seeing far away.

learn.zh: tele 是“远”：television 电视（看远处的东西），telephone 电话（远处传来的声音）。

talks.en: A bicycle has two wheels. Look at its name!
talks.zh: 自行车有两个轮子，看看它的名字！

learn.zh: bi 二 + cycle 轮子。tricycle 是三轮车，tri 是三，triangle 是三角形。

talks.en: Is a pineapple a kind of apple?

learn.zh: 最早 pineapple 指的是松果。后来人们觉得菠萝长得像松果，就借来叫它了。

talks.en: Muscle means little mouse!

learn.zh: 肌肉来自拉丁语“小老鼠”：肌肉动起来，像皮下有只小老鼠在跑。

talks.en: January has a god with two faces.
talks.zh: 一月里藏着一个有两张脸的神。

learn.zh: 来自古罗马的双面神 Janus：一张脸看过去，一张脸看未来。一年的开头正好。

talks.en: Why is it called the alphabet?

learn.zh: 希腊字母的头两个是 alpha 和 beta，合起来就是“字母表”。

talks.en: Nobody is sure where OK came from!
talks.zh: 没人确定 OK 是从哪来的！

learn.zh: 最常见的说法：1839 年美国报纸开玩笑，把 all correct 故意写成 oll korrect，缩写成 OK。

talks.en: Shampoo comes from India.

learn.zh: 来自印地语，原来的意思是“按摩、揉一揉”。

talks.en: School once meant free time!
talks.zh: school 原来的意思是“空闲时间”！

learn.zh: 来自希腊语 skholē，意思是“空闲时间”：有空了，才去学习、讨论。

talks.en: A pencil was once a little tail!

learn.zh: pencil 来自拉丁语“小尾巴”。最早的笔是用毛做的小刷子。

talks.en: It's late. Tonight is a short one.
talks.zh: 很晚了，今晚上一节短的。

learn.zh: today、tonight、tomorrow 都是 to 开头：今天、今晚、明天。

talks.en: Try this one slowly, then fast!

learn.text: She sells seashells by the seashore.
learn.zh: 她在海边卖贝壳。练 s 和 sh：s 舌尖抵着下牙，sh 嘴唇往前撅。

talks.en: Say this three times. Go!

learn.zh: 红卡车，黄卡车。lorry 是英国说的卡车。练 r 和 l：l 舌尖顶上牙后面。

talks.en: Ready? Say it with me!
talks.zh: 准备好了吗？跟我一起说！

learn.text: A big black bug bit a big black bear.
learn.zh: 一只大黑虫咬了一只大黑熊。练 b，嘴唇先闭紧再弹开。

talks.en: Can you say this without a mistake?
talks.zh: 你能一个都不错地说下来吗？

learn.text: Fred fed Ted bread, and Ted fed Fred bread.
learn.zh: Fred 喂 Ted 面包，Ted 也喂 Fred 面包。fed 是 feed（喂）的过去式。

talks.en: This one is for cat lovers!

learn.text: Kitty caught the kitten in the kitchen.
learn.zh: Kitty 在厨房抓住了小猫。练 k，还有 kitchen 里的 tch。caught 是 catch 的过去式。

talks.en: Here is a short one. Try it!

learn.zh: 哪个女巫是哪个？which 和 witch 读音几乎一样，很难分出来。

talks.en: Say it five times fast!

learn.text: Four fine fresh fish for you.
learn.zh: 给你四条新鲜的好鱼。练 f：上牙轻轻碰下嘴唇。

talks.en: Only three words, but very hard!

learn.text: Toy boat. Toy boat. Toy boat.
learn.zh: 玩具船。连说五遍试试，舌头会打结。

talks.en: Say this one with a big smile!

learn.text: I scream, you scream, we all scream for ice cream!
learn.zh: 我叫你叫，我们都为冰淇淋叫！I scream 和 ice cream 听起来一模一样。

talks.en: Here is a famous one. Ready?
talks.zh: 这是一句很有名的，准备好了吗？

learn.text: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.
learn.zh: 彼得·派柏摘了一大筐腌辣椒。英语里最有名的绕口令，练 p。

talks.en: A scary one. Say it slowly!

learn.zh: 六具黏糊糊的骷髅。练 s 连着别的辅音：st、sk。

talks.en: Can your mum say this one?

learn.text: Betty Botter bought some butter, but the butter was bitter.
learn.zh: Betty Botter 买了些黄油，可是黄油是苦的。练 b 和 t。

talks.en: Slowly first. Then faster!

learn.text: Silly Sally swiftly shooed seven silly sheep.
learn.zh: 傻乎乎的 Sally 飞快地赶走七只傻乎乎的羊。练 s 和 sh。

talks.en: One for animal lovers!

learn.zh: 十一头善良的大象。练 l 和 v：v 上牙碰下唇，还要震动。

talks.en: Let's warm up our mouth!

learn.zh: 三次罚球。th 舌尖放在上下牙中间，fr 先咬下唇再卷舌。

talks.en: This one is a bear story!

learn.text: Fuzzy Wuzzy was a bear. Fuzzy Wuzzy had no hair. Fuzzy Wuzzy wasn't fuzzy, was he?
learn.zh: 毛毛熊是只熊，毛毛熊没有毛，毛毛熊不毛，对吧？最后一句是反问。

talks.en: Say it ten times if you can!

learn.zh: 红皮革，黄皮革。比 lorry 那句还难，练 r 和 l。

talks.en: Your mouth will get tired!

learn.zh: 一把像样的铜咖啡壶。练 p 和 k。

talk_make.note: 个性化的“老师说 + 学一点”，由 lines.js 用她的数据填空（talk）。{pair} {w} {other} {topic} {n} 是程序填的；每种都有几句英文轮着用。

zh: 关于 {pair} 的一个小提醒。

be_agree.text: I am, he is, they are.
be_agree.zh: I 用 am，he、she、it 用 is，you、we、they 用 are。

he_she.text: My mum? She is a teacher.
he_she.zh: 男的用 he，女的用 she。妈妈、姐姐、女老师都用 she。

subj_obj.text: I like cats. Cats like me.
subj_obj.zh: 在动词前面当主语用 I，在动词、介词后面用 me：with me, help me。

subj_vs_poss.text: I have a cat. My cat is white.
subj_vs_poss.zh: I 是“我”，my 是“我的”，my 后面要跟东西。

obj_vs_poss.text: Help me. This is my bag.
obj_vs_poss.zh: me 是“我”（宾格），my 是“我的”，后面跟东西：my bag。

poss_adj_vs_pron.text: This is my book. It's mine.
poss_adj_vs_pron.zh: my 后面要跟东西，mine 自己就够了。your / yours、her / hers 也一样。

poss_person.text: Tom and his dog. Amy and her cat.
poss_person.zh: 看主人是男是女：男的用 his，女的用 her。

there_have.text: There is a cat in the box. I have a cat.
there_have.zh: “某处有”用 there is / are；“某人有”用 have / has。

there_be_agree.text: There is a cat. There are two cats.
there_be_agree.zh: 看紧跟在后面的名词：一个用 is，两个以上用 are。

there_order.text: There is a box under the tree.
there_order.zh: 顺序：There is + 东西 + 地点。地点放最后。

poss_of_overuse.text: my sister's room, the door of the room
poss_of_overuse.zh: 人和动物用 's：my sister's room；东西常用 of：the door of the room。

poss_plural.zh: 复数已经有 s，只加撇号：students'。不规则复数照常加 's：children's。

be_missing.text: She is happy. They are at school.
be_missing.zh: 说“是、在、怎么样”时别漏了 am / is / are：She is happy.

be_plus_verb.zh: 有了动词就不用 is：She likes cats，不说 She is like cats。

plural_missing.zh: 两个以上，名词后面加 s：two cats, three books。

uncountable_plural.zh: milk、water、rice、bread 数不清，不加 s：some milk。

third_s_missing.text: I like cats. She likes cats.
third_s_missing.zh: he、she、it 或一个人做主语，动词加 s：She likes cats。

third_s_extra.text: I like it. They play football.
third_s_extra.zh: I、you、we、they 后面的动词不加 s。

third_s_spelling.text: watch → watches, study → studies, have → has
third_s_spelling.zh: ch、sh、s、x 结尾加 es；辅音 + y 改 y 为 i 加 es；have 变 has。

do_does.text: Do you like cats? Does she like dogs?
do_does.zh: I、you、we、they 用 do；he、she、it 用 does。

does_verb_s.zh: does 已经“加了 s”，后面的动词用原形：Does she like，不说 likes。

be_do_mix.text: Is she happy? Does she like it?
be_do_mix.zh: 后面是形容词、地点用 is；后面是动词用 does。

not_order.text: She is not tall. He can't swim.
not_order.zh: not 放在 is / can / do 后面：is not, can not, does not。

not_missing.text: She isn't here. He doesn't like milk.

q_order.text: Can you swim? Is she ten?
q_order.zh: 问句把 is / can / do 放到最前面：Can you swim?

short_answer.text: Are you OK? Yes, I am. No, I'm not.
short_answer.zh: 怎么问就怎么答：Are you...? Yes, I am. Do you...? Yes, I do.

plural_rule.zh: s、x、ch、sh 结尾加 es；辅音 + y 改 y 为 i 加 es。

plural_irregular.text: child → children, man → men, sheep → sheep

a_plural.text: a cat, this book, these books
a_plural.zh: a 和 this 后面只跟一个：a cat；这些用 these books。

a_an.text: an apple, an egg, a cat
a_an.zh: 元音开头的音前用 an：an apple；其他用 a：a cat。

modal_s.zh: can 自己不加 s，后面的动词也不加 s。

modal_to.zh: can 后面直接跟动词，不加 to：can swim。

modal_do.text: I can't swim. Can you swim?
modal_do.zh: can 自己就能变否定和问句：can't、Can you...?，不借 do。

can_cant.text: I can swim, but I can't dance.
can_cant.zh: can 是能、会做；can't 是做不到。听的时候注意尾巴上的 t。

can_who.text: Can I help you? Can you help me?
can_who.zh: Can I 是“我可以……吗”，Can you 是“你能……吗”。

adv_meaning.zh: always 总这样，usually 通常，often 经常，sometimes 有时，never 从不。

adv_position.text: I often read. She is always happy.
adv_position.zh: 频度副词放在一般动词前、be 动词后：I often read. She is always happy.

how_often.text: How often? Twice a week. How many? Two.
how_often.zh: How often 问多久一次，How many 问有几个。

word_order.zh: 英语顺序：谁 + 做什么 + 什么 + 在哪儿。

adj_order.text: a white cat, a big black dog
adj_order.zh: 形容词放在名词前面：a white cat，不说 a cat white。

place_time.text: I read at home every day.
place_time.zh: 地点在前，时间在后，一起放句子最后。

wh_order.zh: 问句顺序：Where + is + 主语：Where is your bag?

wh_word.text: What is it? Where is it? Who is he?
wh_word.zh: what 问东西，where 问地方，who 问人，when 问时间。

wh_keep.zh: 问“做什么”要借 do / does：What do you like?

some_any.text: I have some milk. Do you have any milk?
some_any.zh: 肯定句用 some，否定句和问句用 any。

category: {w} and {other}: same group, not the same!

zh.category: {w} 和 {other} 是一类，可不一样！

en: Here is a word you just learned: {w}.
zh: 课本这个单元的一个词：{w}。

lines.learn_zh: 我也是！别人说 I like ...，你也喜欢，就说 So do I! 或者 Me too!
be into 就是“很喜欢、迷上”：I'm into {topic}. 我很迷{topic_zh}。
真酷，真不错！听到有意思的事时说。cool 本来是“凉快的”。

lines.en: {n} days in a row! Keep it up!
lines.zh: 连着 {n} 天了！继续保持！
lines.learn_zh: 连着，一连。three days in a row = 连着三天。Keep it up! 是“继续保持”。

lines.en: Day {n} in a row. You are on a roll!
lines.zh: 连着第 {n} 天了，状态正好！
lines.learn_zh: 状态正好，一件接一件做成，像球一直往前滚。

lines.en: {n} days! Keep up the good work!
lines.learn_zh: 继续好好干！夸别人坚持的时候说。
